composition_rules.moves_and_drops: no new production event; original production funds release
composition_rules.mul: MULCORE includes scratch storage; the result is produced at its full span before multiplication; only NORMALIZE at output
composition_rules.divmod: DIVCORE includes internal temporary storage; no extra scratch charge

status: quick run with shortened measurements; for checking the machine and estimating duration only

metadata.Wall_Seconds: summary median or sample value; Schnorr samples are normalized to 80,000 validations.
metadata.Full_Varops_Wall_Seconds: natural legal-script runtime extrapolated to exactly 40 billion varops.

F.notes: NOP evaluator time divided by executed instructions. Includes parsing/prescan and amortized entry/finalization, not pure CPU dispatch.

PREP.notes: Fit uses pre-reserved inputs. Tight-capacity inputs remain visible as excluded growth diagnostics; their extra work still needs coverage in complete compositions. Shortest batch is only 1.5 µs: timer/cache noise may be material.

PRODUCE.notes: Complete allocation, population, insertion and release. Multi-event fixtures are plotted per production event; all charged bytes remain represented.

NORMALIZE.notes: Numeric materialization only. Original allocation, stack insertion and later release are outside the timer. Shortest batch is only 0.96 µs: timer/cache noise may be material.

ARITH.notes: Shortest batch is only 1.6 µs: timer/cache noise may be material.

BIT.notes: Bitwise logic, shifts and byte reversal (OP_BYTEREV): word passes without a carry chain.

MULCORE.notes: Complete prepared OP_MUL: fixed setup + coefficient x u longer-operand limbs + coefficient x v rows (one per shorter-operand limb) + coefficient x u*v limb products, on a zeroed product buffer created beforehand. Product creation, release and final byte conversion are charged separately.

DIVCORE.notes: Complete prepared DIV/MOD: fixed setup + coefficient x s + coefficient x s*v. Storage and normalization are included; do not add overlapping MUL/storage charges. Shortest batch is only 2.5 µs: timer/cache noise may be material.

H256.notes: Core SHA256 over the padded 64-byte-block span.

H160.notes: Direct RIPEMD160 domain ends at 520 bytes. Includes the 32-byte HASH160 intermediate input.

H1.notes: Direct SHA1 domain ends at 520 bytes.

SIG.notes: Plot shows complete signature verification. Fit estimates a nonnegative constant over the fitted H256(64+n) allowance; it does not independently identify curve-only work. The provisional candidate fixes SIG at 500,000 varops for sigops parity instead of using the fitted conversion.

TWEAK.notes: One fixture only; no size dependence or repeatability test.

SELECT.notes: Complete collated EvalOpTx per charged unit: each planned value and each record scanned for an aggregate field. Includes planning, framing, producing the one result and cleanup. Noncollated output also pays WRITE per value and is a diagnostic.

UNROLL.notes: Complete evaluation of inactive macro references per charged unit (substituted instruction or visited reference), against unrolled bytes per unit.
